_meta.description: Scenario/objective card library for the Legion app. Covers the current (post-'2.6 refresh', July 2024 onward) Battle Card system: a 9-card Battle Deck per player (3 Primary Objective, 3 Secondary Objective, 3 Advantage), built collaboratively during Setup's 'Building a Mission' step.

game_formats.recon-600: 600-point 'Recon' format -- smaller board, shorter game. Uses its own comparable-but-different card set, not yet catalogued here.

_meta.deprecated_system_warning: IMPORTANT: an older card system (separate Objective / Deployment / Condition cards, 800pt standard / 500pt skirmish format) was replaced by the Primary/Secondary/Advantage system described here as of the Legion 2.6.0 Core Rulebook update (~July 2024). The old cards are explicitly no longer supported for play. If any other file in this project (e.g. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) still references 800pt/500pt or 'Objective/Deployment/Condition' terminology, that's now confirmed stale and needs fixing -- see docs/TODO.md.
_meta.battle_deck_rule: 9 cards per player: 3 Primary Objective + 3 Secondary Objective + 3 Advantage, no duplicates. Corresponding Map cards accompany Primary Objectives.
_meta.distinct_from_campaigns_feature: AMG also publishes non-competitive 'Scenario' cards for narrative/thematic play (distinct from competitive Primary/Secondary/Advantage cards) -- these are NOT the same thing as this app's user-defined Campaigns feature, which remains an intentional placeholder per docs/TODO.md and docs/DECISIONS.md. AMG's official narrative Scenario cards are a separate, uncatalogued gap -- see below.
_meta.verification_status: STANDARD PRIMARY OBJECTIVE ROSTER COMPLETE (2026-08-25). All 10 current Standard Primary Objectives are catalogued: the six original 2.6 objectives confirmed by AMG's official updated-card/errata roster plus the four Primary Objectives from Battle Deck Card Pack II (released 2026-03-20). Supply Run was corrected from an unverified Primary seed entry to its current Secondary Objective category. Gameplay/scoring fields were filled only where clean current support was available; Contact, Contact!, Payload, and Cauldron intentionally retain blank gameplay fields pending clean current card transcriptions. Secondary Objectives, Advantages, Recon cards, and official narrative Scenarios remain incomplete and will be expanded in separate passes.

primary_objectives.name: Breakthrough
primary_objectives.deployment_note: Post-2.6, deployment is built into the objective/map card itself rather than a separate Deployment card category.
primary_objectives.points_of_interest: 4 POIs, with 2 in each player's territory.
primary_objectives.victory_condition: Starting in Round 2, during each End Phase, score 1 VP for each of your own POIs that is not contested and 2 VPs for each enemy POI you Secure.
primary_objectives.notes: Current 2.6 Objective. Roster/title is official; scoring and POI layout cross-checked against current objective-guide coverage.

primary_objectives.name: Bunker Assault
primary_objectives.deployment_note: Post-2.6, deployment is built into the objective/map card itself rather than a separate Deployment card category.
primary_objectives.points_of_interest: 4 Bunker POIs, 2 associated with each side.
primary_objectives.victory_condition: Starting in Round 2, during each End Phase, score 1 VP for each Bunker POI you Secure. Destroying an enemy Bunker is worth 3 VPs.
primary_objectives.notes: Current 2.6 Objective. Enemy Bunkers can be damaged and destroyed through the objective's Special Rules.

primary_objectives.name: Cauldron
primary_objectives.deployment_note: Post-2.6, deployment is built into the objective/map card itself rather than a separate Deployment card category.
primary_objectives.notes: Added in Battle Deck Card Pack II (2026). Current coverage describes securing Waypoints and a suppression-related special rule; exact card text left blank pending a clean transcription.

primary_objectives.name: Close the Pocket
primary_objectives.deployment_note: Post-2.6, deployment is built into the objective/map card itself rather than a separate Deployment card category.
primary_objectives.points_of_interest: 3 POIs: 1 central POI and 2 flanking POIs.
primary_objectives.victory_condition: Starting in Round 2, during each End Phase, the central POI is worth 2 VPs when Secured and each flanking POI is worth 1 VP when Secured.
primary_objectives.notes: Current 2.6 Objective. Roster/title is official; scoring and POI layout cross-checked against current objective-guide coverage.

primary_objectives.name: Contact, Contact!
primary_objectives.deployment_note: Post-2.6, deployment is built into the objective/map card itself rather than a separate Deployment card category.
primary_objectives.notes: Added in Battle Deck Card Pack II (2026). Current coverage describes securing Listening Outposts that provide Precise 1; exact setup/scoring text left blank pending a clean card transcription.

primary_objectives.name: Intercept Signals
primary_objectives.deployment_note: Post-2.6, deployment is built into the objective/map card itself rather than a separate Deployment card category.
primary_objectives.points_of_interest: 4 POIs: 1 in each player's territory and 2 along the midfield line.
primary_objectives.victory_condition: Starting in Round 2, during each End Phase, score 1 VP for each qualifying POI outside your own territory that you Secure, or that is contested by one of your units with an Intel token.
primary_objectives.notes: Current 2.6 Objective. Each player designates units that receive Intel tokens during setup.

primary_objectives.name: Outflank
primary_objectives.deployment_note: Post-2.6, deployment is built into the objective/map card itself rather than a separate Deployment card category.
primary_objectives.points_of_interest: 4 POIs: 2 central and 1 on each flank.
primary_objectives.victory_condition: Starting in Round 2, during each End Phase, score 1 VP for each POI you Secure, plus up to 1 bonus VP if at least 2 of your Vanguard units are securing one or more POIs.
primary_objectives.notes: Added in Battle Deck Card Pack II (2026). Uses Vanguard units as an additional scoring mechanism.

primary_objectives.name: Payload
primary_objectives.deployment_note: Post-2.6, deployment is built into the objective/map card itself rather than a separate Deployment card category.
primary_objectives.notes: Added in Battle Deck Card Pack II (2026). Uses Bomb Cart objectives; exact current 2026 card scoring text left blank rather than importing the obsolete pre-2.6 Payload card text.

primary_objectives.name: Recover the Research
primary_objectives.deployment_note: Post-2.6, deployment is built into the objective/map card itself rather than a separate Deployment card category.
primary_objectives.points_of_interest: 6 POIs, arranged as 3 in front of each player's territory.
primary_objectives.victory_condition: Starting in Round 2, during each End Phase: score 1 VP if your units contest at least 2 POIs, 2 VPs for at least 3, or 3 VPs for at least 4.
primary_objectives.notes: Current 2.6 Objective. Roster/title is official; scoring and POI layout cross-checked against current objective-guide coverage.

primary_objectives.name: Shifting Priorities
primary_objectives.deployment_note: Post-2.6, deployment is built into the objective/map card itself rather than a separate Deployment card category.
primary_objectives.victory_condition: Starting in Round 2, during each End Phase, score 1 VP for each Priority Target POI you Secure.
primary_objectives.notes: Current 2.6 Objective. After scoring, secured Priority Targets can shift position according to the card's Special Rules.

secondary_objectives.notes: Current Secondary Objective from Battle Deck Card Pack II (2026). Moved from primary_objectives because the seed explicitly had its category unverified.
